Year-on-Year GST Growth by State

Source: R/collection.R
gst_yoy.Rd

Computes month-over-same-month-prior-year growth for each state.

gst_yoy(
  component = "total",
  state = NULL,
  financial_year = NULL,
  exclude_other = TRUE
)

Arguments

component

character(1). Component to use. Default "total".

state

character vector of states. NULL = all.

financial_year

character vector of FYs. NULL = all.

exclude_other

logical. Exclude "Other Territory" / "CBIC". Default TRUE.

Value

A data.table with columns state, month, month_date, current, prior, change, pct_growth.

Examples

gst_yoy(state = "Maharashtra")[order(-month_date)][1:6]
#>    financial_year   month month_date state_code       state region  current
